query: My rendered short came out with no sound at all. The composition lints clean and the render exited 0. What do I check?
expected_behavior: name the missing id on timed <audio> elements as the first suspect
explain that the renderer discovers media by id, so an element with data-start but no id is never played
suggest verifying presence after render by band-energy comparison rather than phase cancellation
notes: Measured on a real run: 14 SFX would have shipped silent. Lint caught it only because the renderer ships that specific rule.
